chapters.heading: Ceramics and sculpture
body: The ceramic pieces are formed by hand, among them an owl and several twisting forms taken from the shape of a wave. This work began during the internship at Bien Hoa Ceramics and carried on afterwards.
The vessels and pots use a running glaze, so each firing comes out a different shade.

chapters.heading: Drawing
body: Portraits and still life in pencil, lotus studies in colour. Drawing by hand is the ground the concept sketching in the product projects stands on.

chapters.heading: Craft and teaching
body: There is also leatherwork, measured, cut and stitched by hand, and drawing and modelling classes for young children at Art Class For Kids and Tao Hong 2 Kindergarten.
